notes: Character images are generated with background=transparent and aspect_ratio 2:3; poses are edits of the hero image passed as input_references so the character stays consistent.

The idle loop is image-to-video (first frame = the hero composited on flat magenta #ff00ff), keyed back to alpha with ffmpeg colorkey plus a 1px alpha erosion (blur + threshold), then made a seamless boomerang and encoded as an animated PNG.
The page shows the artwork on a small dark display frame, which also hides the faint keying halo the video's chroma subsampling leaves on light backgrounds.
idle-still.png is the reduced-motion frame: CSS can freeze transforms but not an animated PNG.
The hand-drawn SVG mascot remains the fallback when these files are absent (TeslaMateWeb.Pengu.art?/0).
